claims.claim: PRIMARY restart uses the active package source, snapshots it before synchronization when it resides in the control checkout, and removes the synchronized checkout source from PYTHONPATH. Focused regression tests cover changed package source and TASK state; existing same-generation synchronization tests passed.

The versioned migration intent binds exact source and target generation SHAs, downstream repository and control commits, pin artifacts, TASK identity, and Executor. Admission rejects stale or mismatched identities using repository-neutral Git checks.

An exclusive handoff record transfers PRIMARY authority to the exact target source. The target consumes it once, rechecks control state, and admits only the bound TASK. Tested pre-handoff rejections leave the control checkout and remote tracking ref unchanged, invoke no Executor, create no RUN, and record an admission failure.
Brain Portability documentation records the reusable N-to-N+1 invariant and retains explicit reviewed BP-9 downstream adoption.
